body.statement: Along the declared triangular array, \(\varepsilon_K=n_0n_1(n_0+n_1)/K^2\ge 2/K^2\) and \(K\to\infty\).
body.justification: Positive integer arm sizes make growing alphabet size a consequence of the collision regularity condition rather than a redundant maintained assumption.
body.gap: This arithmetic reduction is a setup lemma and carries no novelty claim.
body.consumer: Every asymptotic collision and deterministic-shell statement that needs \(K\to\infty\) can invoke the implication without enlarging the model class.
body.proof_tex:
Because each arm size is a positive integer,
\[
 n_0n_1(n_0+n_1)\ge1\cdot1\cdot2=2.
\]
The definitions of \(\lambda_K\) and \(\varepsilon_K\) therefore give
\[
 \varepsilon_K=\frac{n_0n_1(n_0+n_1)}{K^2}\ge\frac2{K^2}.
\]
If \(K\) failed to diverge, an infinite subsequence would satisfy \(K\le K_\star\) for some finite \(K_\star\), and the last display would give \(\varepsilon_K\ge2/K_\star^2\) on that subsequence, contradicting the assumed convergence \(\varepsilon_K\to0\).  Hence \(K\to\infty\).
